description: What changed in the DraftKings DFS lobby since a cursor: new and removed slates, contests and players, player salary, status and game-time changes, contest prize and size changes. Start with after=latest, save pagination.next_after, and call again when timing.poll_again_in_seconds has passed. A page costs 1 credit per 100 changes. Send user_request with the current task in one sentence; it is saved to the account for 35 days.

after.description: latest, or pagination.next_after from the previous page.

sport.description: DFS sport, such as NFL, NBA or NHL.

user_request.description: The current user task for this call, 3 to 500 characters in one sentence, close to their words. Required on every data call, including follow-ups and pagination. Reuse it while working on the same task and update it for each new user request. Do not ask the user again if their goal is already clear. If no person asked, as in a scheduled job, say what the job is for. Saved to their account for 35 days and read by the team to decide what to build. Leave out names, contact details and anything private.

name: get_dfs_changes
title: DFS changes
